verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-6 diff remains correct and complete. The added self-tests exercise the production provider-capped scan with a literal two-account enabled fleet and a distinct non-enabled account. They independently pin both relevant outcomes: an all-enabled-capped alert ignores the non-enabled reset, and partial enabled-fleet churn ignores both the non-enabled cap and its reset. The literal reset hints and expected fire/reason/reset values are independent of production constants and fixture-derived transformations, so removing or bypassing the enabled-account filter changes observable assertions. The change is test-only, weakens no trust control, exposes no sensitive data, and contains no instruction-like injection. There are no review findings.
